structuredData.headline: Meta Launches Seller App for Facebook Marketplace: A New Era
structuredData.description: Meta launches 'Seller,' a dedicated app for Facebook Marketplace, offering sellers streamlined tools for inventory and sales. This strategic move reinforces Meta's commitment to social commerce and opens new opportunities for business growth.
